## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm bundle` pass.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for new logic.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for user-facing changes.
- [ ] For UI changes, manual smoke checklist results are attached (see [manual smoke checklist](docs/development.md#ручной-smoke-чек-лист-extension-development-host)).
- [ ] No secrets, internal hostnames or real account/workspace ids appear in code, tests, logs or screenshots.
